# Stampn

> Stampn is a digital loyalty and rewards platform for cafés, restaurants, salons, gyms, and shops. Customers add stamp cards and points cards straight to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet — no app download required. Built Arabic-first for Egypt and the region.

Stampn is currently pre-launch. The public marketing site introduces the product and lets businesses join the launch waitlist. Businesses that join get free white-glove setup, priority onboarding, and founding-member pricing.

## Key facts

- Product: digital loyalty cards (stamp cards + points programs) delivered to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet.
- No customer app: customers tap "Add to Wallet" — nothing to download or install.
- Merchant dashboard: businesses issue stamps, hand out rewards, and push instant card updates to customers' lock screens.
- Audience: cafés, restaurants, salons, gyms, and retail shops in Egypt and the wider region.
- Languages: English and Arabic (Arabic-first). English site at "/", Arabic site at "/ar".
- Status: pre-launch; onboarding a first wave of businesses via the waitlist.

## Pages

- [Home](https://stampn.net/): What Stampn is and how it works.
- [Get started / Join the waitlist](https://stampn.net/get-started): Reserve a spot — leave name, email, phone, and business name; the team reaches out within one day.
- [Support / Contact](https://stampn.net/support): Send a message; the team replies by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://stampn.net/privacy): What data the site collects and how it is used.
